sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m',payment_date) month, COUNT(*) payments, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) customers,SUM(amount) total,MIN(amount) min_amount,MAX(amount) max_amount FROM payment GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH m AS (SELECT customer_id,strftime('%Y-%m',payment_date) month,SUM(amount) total,AVG(amount) mean FROM payment GROUP BY 1,2),d AS (SELECT *,LAG(total) OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month) prev,LAG(mean) OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month) prev_mean FROM m),s AS (SELECT customer_id,COUNT(prev) n,AVG(total-prev) signed_change,AVG(ABS(total-prev)) absolute_change,AVG((total-prev)*1.0/NULLIF(prev,0)) rate,AVG(mean-prev_mean) mean_change FROM d GROUP BY 1) SELECT s.*,c.first_name||' '||c.last_name name FROM s JOIN customer c USING(customer_id) ORDER BY signed_change DESC LIMIT 10

WITH m AS (SELECT customer_id,strftime('%Y-%m',payment_date) month,SUM(amount) total,AVG(amount) mean FROM payment GROUP BY 1,2),d AS (SELECT *,LAG(total) OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month) prev,LAG(mean) OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month) prev_mean FROM m),s AS (SELECT customer_id,COUNT(prev) n,AVG(total-prev) signed_change,AVG(ABS(total-prev)) absolute_change,AVG((total-prev)*1.0/NULLIF(prev,0)) rate,AVG(mean-prev_mean) mean_change FROM d GROUP BY 1) SELECT 'absolute' variant,s.customer_id,c.first_name||' '||c.last_name name,absolute_change metric FROM s JOIN customer c USING(customer_id) WHERE absolute_change=(SELECT MAX(absolute_change) FROM s) UNION ALL SELECT 'rate',s.customer_id,c.first_name||' '||c.last_name,rate FROM s JOIN customer c USING(customer_id) WHERE rate=(SELECT MAX(rate) FROM s) UNION ALL SELECT 'monthly_average',s.customer_id,c.first_name||' '||c.last_name,mean_change FROM s JOIN customer c USING(customer_id) WHERE mean_change=(SELECT MAX(mean_change) FROM s)

WITH RECURSIVE months(month) AS (SELECT date(MIN(payment_date),'start of month') FROM payment UNION ALL SELECT date(month,'+1 month') FROM months WHERE month<(SELECT date(MAX(payment_date),'start of month') FROM payment)), m AS(SELECT c.customer_id,month,COALESCE(SUM(p.amount),0) total FROM customer c CROSS JOIN months LEFT JOIN payment p ON p.customer_id=c.customer_id AND date(p.payment_date,'start of month')=month GROUP BY 1,2),d AS(SELECT *,LAG(total) OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month) prev FROM m),s AS(SELECT customer_id,AVG(total-prev) metric FROM d GROUP BY 1) SELECT s.*,c.first_name||' '||c.last_name name FROM s JOIN customer c USING(customer_id) ORDER BY metric DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT customer_id,strftime('%Y-%m',payment_date) month,SUM(amount) total,COUNT(*) payments FROM payment WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM (WITH m AS (SELECT customer_id,strftime('%Y-%m',payment_date) month,SUM(amount) total,AVG(amount) mean FROM payment GROUP BY 1,2),d AS (SELECT *,LAG(total) OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month) prev,LAG(mean) OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month) prev_mean FROM m),s AS (SELECT customer_id,COUNT(prev) n,AVG(total-prev) signed_change,AVG(ABS(total-prev)) absolute_change,AVG((total-prev)*1.0/NULLIF(prev,0)) rate,AVG(mean-prev_mean) mean_change FROM d GROUP BY 1) SELECT customer_id FROM s ORDER BY signed_change DESC LIMIT 3)) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH m AS (SELECT customer_id,strftime('%Y-%m',payment_date) month,SUM(amount) total,AVG(amount) mean FROM payment GROUP BY 1,2),d AS (SELECT *,LAG(total) OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month) prev,LAG(mean) OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month) prev_mean FROM m),s AS (SELECT customer_id,COUNT(prev) n,AVG(total-prev) signed_change,AVG(ABS(total-prev)) absolute_change,AVG((total-prev)*1.0/NULLIF(prev,0)) rate,AVG(mean-prev_mean) mean_change FROM d GROUP BY 1) SELECT c.first_name||' '||c.last_name full_name FROM s JOIN customer c USING(customer_id) WHERE signed_change=(SELECT MAX(signed_change) FROM s)

WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT p.customer_id AS customer_id,
         strftime('%Y-%m', p.payment_date) AS ym,
         SUM(p.amount) AS val
  FROM payment p
  GROUP BY p.customer_id, strftime('%Y-%m', p.payment_date)
), pairs AS (
  SELECT m1.customer_id AS customer_id,
         m1.val - m2.val AS chg
  FROM monthly m1
  JOIN monthly m2
    ON m2.customer_id = m1.customer_id
   AND m2.ym = strftime('%Y-%m', date(m1.ym || '-01', '-1 month'))
), avg_chg AS (
  SELECT customer_id, AVG(chg) AS avg_monthly_change
  FROM pairs GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name AS full_name
FROM avg_chg a
JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id
ORDER BY a.avg_monthly_change DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH m AS(SELECT customer_id,strftime('%Y-%m',payment_date) ym,SUM(amount) val FROM payment GROUP BY 1,2),s AS(SELECT a.customer_id,AVG(ABS(a.val-b.val)) metric FROM m a JOIN m b ON a.customer_id=b.customer_id AND b.ym=strftime('%Y-%m',date(a.ym||'-01','-1 month')) GROUP BY 1) SELECT c.first_name||' '||c.last_name name,s.* FROM s JOIN customer c USING(customer_id) ORDER BY metric DESC LIMIT 3
